description.value: The study examined brain reactivity to alcohol and cannabis marketing cues during sobriety and intoxication using pharmacological fMRI in heavy alcohol users, regular cannabis users and controls.

spans.text: The aim of the present study was to assess the impact of alcohol and cannabis marketing on the brain's reward circuit.

value: It was predicted that alcohol and cannabis marketing would increase brain activation in the striatum when sober.
reinforcement of the striatum after marketing exposure will be less during intoxication as compared with when sober

spans.text: It was predicted that brain networks that are activated after alcohol/cannabis marketing exposure are similar during sobriety and intoxication, but that reinforcement of the striatum after marketing exposure will be less during intoxication as compared with when sober.

description.value: A double-blind, placebo-controlled, mixed-factorial study with heavy alcohol users, regular cannabis users and an age-matched control group; treatment conditions were balanced over participants and separated by at least seven days.
